title: Offline Achievements
tagline: Earn it on a plane. It counts when you land.
what: My offline mode for RetroAchievements keeps classic-game unlocks on the handheld until I'm back online. On the Thor, each one appears as Steam's own achievement pop-up.
built: Rewrote the catalog storage as one small file per game
A faster offline mode for the tool I started from
A relay that turns every unlock into Steam's own pop-up on the Thor
Matched 4,684 games across 33 systems to their achievement sets

remix.changed: A faster offline mode, plus a relay that shows the pop-ups in Steam on the Thor.

making.problem: RetroAchievements checks in with its servers the moment you earn something. On a plane, in the car, anywhere without signal, the unlock just doesn't count.
how: Every emulator's achievement calls go to a small relay on the device instead of straight to the internet.
The relay hands them to the offline proxy, which answers from a local copy of the whole achievement catalog and holds your unlocks until you're back online.
A Steam plugin turns each unlock into Steam's own achievement pop-up, so it feels like part of the Thor.

broke.title: A catalog that fits
broke.body: I changed the cache to one small file per entry: 2,786 games run in 25 MB, where 1,000 took 172 MB before. Badges load from RetroArch's own image cache, ready offline.

credits: Storage rewrite, relay, Steam pop-ups and Thor setup: me
